claim_title: Omega-3 supplementation reduces cardiovascular events in women
caption: **Omega-3s and heart events in women.** The main reviewed study pooled 18 trials with over 134,000 people and found modest reductions in heart attacks and cardiovascular death — but it never analyzed women separately, and women made up anywhere from 0% to 69% of participants. The **effect sizes are small and close to no effect**, and the significant results disappeared when one or two trials were removed. There isn't enough sex-specific evidence to support the claim for women.
subtitle: The pooled data showed small effects and was never broken down by sex.
